thread.title: The iPhone XR has been Apple's best-selling phone since its launch: report - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: The iPhone XR has been Apple's best-selling phone since its launch: report - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +3.85% new iPhone XR has been the company's best-selling phone since the device first went on sale in late October, the company's vice president of product marketing Greg Joswiak told Cnet on Wednesday . The iPhone XR has been Apple's "most popular iPhone each and every day since the day it became available," Joswiak said, according to the report. His comments come as investors worry about underwhelming demand for Apple's latest line of iPhones, including the XR, the cheapest of the new devices. Some analysts expected the XR to help drive a wave of upgrades due to its comprehensive feature set and starting price of $799, which is comparatively low for a new iPhone. Apple shares were inactive in after-hours trading Wednesday, after rising 3.9% during the regular session. Concerns about iPhone demand and tariffs have pressured the stock in recent weeks, with shares off 16% in the past month, compared with a 2.8% rise for the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +2.50% of which Apple is a component.
